content.title: Default run · Fan schedule example

goal.text: Give fans one reliable place to check schedules, voting and application deadlines, source conflicts, and the next safe action.

content.problem: Broadcasts, performances, releases, votes, and applications use different dates and sources. Fans can miss a deadline or act on stale information while moving between them.

intent.statement: Desktop shows the monthly schedule beside the selected date, while mobile presents the same events in date order.
intent.verify: Compare event order, selected-date details, and missing information in the wide and narrow experiences.

statement.text: Every event shows its KST time, primary source, last checked time, and a direct action link when action is required.

intent.verify: Review representative event details and confirm that each required time and source is visible.
intent.reason: Fans need enough source context to judge whether an action is still safe.

intent.statement: Each source observation keeps its value and checked time; source priority selects the displayed schedule while unresolved conflicts, changes, and cancellations remain visible.
intent.verify: Inspect representative event records and screens, then compare retained observations, the resolved display value, visible conflicts, and available actions.
intent.reason: Preserving source observations keeps provenance and later corrections available while fans receive one usable schedule.

statement.text: Official organizers and artists have highest source priority, and action links require a recent check.

intent.verify: Compare representative conflicts and action deadlines against the visible source order and last-checked time.
intent.reason: These sources can confirm changes directly, while voting and application deadlines can change within hours.

intent.statement: The schedule identifies itself as unofficial and sends final participation decisions to the linked official source.
intent.verify: Check the schedule notice and every participation action for an explicit official-source destination.

intent.statement: The chosen direction fits the existing fan site and makes monthly context and urgent actions easy to distinguish.
intent.verify: The person compares the two directions and judges the selected information hierarchy and responsive transition.

exclusions: Voting or applying inside the fan site
A guarantee that every official announcement is collected

options.title: Monthly trust map
options.alt: Monthly fan schedule with a selected-date source panel and visible deadline states
options.summary: Keep the monthly rhythm primary and reveal source confidence and actions for the selected date.
strengths: Fans can scan activity density and overlapping events quickly.
The selected-date panel keeps evidence beside the event.
tradeoffs: Urgent actions are less prominent before a date is selected.

references.influence: Its monthly desktop rhythm and mobile list informed the responsive structure.

options.title: Action deadline radar
options.alt: Fan action planner that prioritizes voting and application deadlines beside a compact calendar
options.summary: Put urgent voting and application actions first while retaining a compact monthly reference.
strengths: Near-term deadlines and their official links are hard to miss.
Conflict and cancellation warnings sit beside each action.
tradeoffs: The month-wide activity pattern takes longer to understand.

references.label: RESCENE STREAM
references.influence: Its separation of schedules and fan actions informed the action-first grouping.

recommendation.reason: It meets the original monthly-schedule goal while keeping source conflicts and action links beside the selected date.

selection.reason: The person delegated the reversible choice and accepted the direction that preserves monthly context.

steps.title: Choose a view
steps.detail: Choose today, week, or month and filter event types.

steps.title: Compare time and urgency
steps.detail: Scan the monthly rhythm together with deadlines, changes, and cancellations.

steps.title: Check the source
steps.detail: Open an event to compare its primary source, other values, and last check.

steps.title: Act at the original
steps.detail: Follow a verified official link or wait for a source correction when a conflict remains.

outcomes.title: Official source opened
outcomes.detail: The fan continues at the recently verified official source.

outcomes.title: Source correction pending
outcomes.detail: The source conflict stays visible while the fan waits for a correction.
